## AMUD Dashboard — Unraid templates
**AMUD** (Advanced Modern Unified Dashboard) is a compiled Rust homelab control center: app launcher, live telemetry, and integrations — with **no YAML** (SQLite config in the UI).
### Install both templates
AMUD uses two lightweight containers that share a Unix socket on disk:
1. **AMUD Dashboard** — Web UI on port 8000 2. **AMUD Agent** — Docker/host telemetry sidecar (required for container stats)
Use the **same** `AMUD_AGENT_SECRET` and the **same** socket path (`/mnt/user/appdata/amud-dashboard/run`) on both containers.
### Links
- Docs: https://boubli.github.io/AMUD-Dashboard/docs/installation/unraid - GitHub: https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard - Support: https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/discussions - Docker Hub: https://hub.docker.com/r/tradmss/amud-dashboard
### Typical RAM usage
Server + agent combined: roughly **35–100MB** in Docker (vs 150MB+ for PHP/Node dashboards).
